planSteps.description: In the handler, call `FileAgent.searchAndMatchFile()` to find the file using the request text
Send the file via `WhatsAppProvider.sendDocument()` with the file path and content
Add error handling for cases where file isn't found or read fails
Pass `searchDirs` (project root) in context to `FileAgent` for file matching
Test by messaging the bot: `send me the PRD file` and verify it arrives on WhatsApp
